objective: Produce fixed-membership FP32 predictions from the already completed V8 linear control and V9 PLE fixed-epoch-0 checkpoints.
scientific_status: No new fit or profile; V8 linear and V9 PLE source fits remain the scientific treatments.

checkpoint_contract.linear_source: E540 V8 completed fixed epoch-0 run; reused without refit
checkpoint_contract.ple_source: E540 V9 completed fixed epoch-0 run; reused without refit
checkpoint_contract.paired_sampler_identity: must exactly match both saved provenance records
checkpoint_contract.paired_normalization_identity: must exactly match both saved provenance records
checkpoint_contract.ple_knot_buffers: must match the original fitted preprocessing digest and 512-component membership

input_data.read_columns: seq_ix and 112 feature columns for exact evaluation_groups only

evaluation.claim_limit: Previously exposed fixed evaluation groups; exports enable the declared comparison only and do not establish a fresh holdout or public forecast.

producer_clock_validation.source_semantics: history train_seconds is rounded and recorded before epoch checkpoint saves; sibling provenance fitting_seconds is rounded and written after saves.
producer_clock_validation.constraint: provenance may trail history only within rounding tolerance; provenance may exceed history only by the declared checkpoint-write allowance plus rounding tolerance
